Sam: Quick update 1: SolarWave closed a 24-month Dedicated contract via the GCP Marketplace today. They started production traffic this morning :tada:.
Maya: Wow, congrats! Any customer quote or logo clearance yet?
Sam: CS got a short blurb: "Redwood's dedicated offering made model serving reliable and 2x cheaper for us." Asked legal for publish ok.
Ravi: Nice! Who's running the case study and marketplace tile refresh?
Jo: I can take the case study + partner tile. Plan: short success story (1 pager), a technical appendix, and a promo tweet.
Sam: Need to complete their network onboarding: VPC peering + private keys. Eng-bot, status?
eng-bot: SolarWave (customer_id: swv-1147) - onboarding checklist: 1) VPC peering configured (awaiting route accept), 2) KMS key policy pending, 3) Dedicated pool tagging. ETA ~36h.
Maya: Timeline for public announcement? We should wait for legal on the quote and for CS to confirm success metrics.
legal-bot: Legal: Received quote request. Auto-review shows no red flags, but need explicit customer sign-off for logo usage. Reply with recorded permission.
Ravi: Technical appendix should show perf delta: baseline 120ms p50 -> 70ms p50 after tuning, token cost down ~27%. I'll draft the perf graphs.
Jo: Can eng folks share a short config snippet for the appendix? Something customers can copy.
Ravi: Sure. I'll paste a sample config in thread after the sync.
Sam: Ops note: SolarWave requested a weekly usage report for the first month. CS, please schedule.
Maya: I'll schedule weekly check-ins (first one next Tue). Also prepping a short internal PR for sales enablement.
Jo: Assignments: Jo (case study + marketplace tile), Ravi (tech appendix + perf graphs), Maya (CS follow-ups + PR), Sam (announce coordination).
Sam: Great work team. Once legal confirms logo/quote, we can aim for a soft announce next Fri. Any blockers post here.
